comments: Open-core. The full engine is AGPL-3.0 at https://github.com/Aelira-AI/aelira-core and runs self-hosted via Docker Compose with no feature gating. A separate command-line client, @aelira/cli (MIT, npm), supports CLI and CI use against a running instance. Remediation is human-in-the-loop by design: fixes are proposed with evidence and require approval before anything is written back to the source system. Canvas is the verified LMS integration in the current release; Brightspace, Blackboard and Moodle connectors are earlier in maturity and labelled as such.
features: Scans and remediates documents and web content against WCAG 2.1 AA. Unlike scan-only tools, Aelira generates and applies fixes: tagged PDF structure, alternative text, reading order, table headers and captions, with human review before write-back. Covers PDF, Microsoft Office documents, LaTeX, HTML and video, with LMS integration for course content.
title: Aelira
